title:
Author the Stage-1 governance/normative deliverables (umbrella .design/thermite2-program.md REQ-8 / AC-13). ENVIRONMENT (use directly, do not probe external files): Verus at /Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus (export VERUS_BIN=/Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus + add dir to PATH); lake at /Users/maxine/.elan/bin. Build the spine if a .rs/.lean header edit needs a compile check: cd lean && lake build Thermite.Stabilize Thermite.Exec.Stmt Thermite.Exec.WhileBody.

Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit. STANDING SELF-VERIFY: python3 tooling/doc-drift.py (topology-stable; re-pin the audited-sha of every design doc whose governed source you touch) + tooling/reqs check; finish 0-drift.

SCOPE: TWO normative deliverables ONLY (NOT the metrics dashboard, NOT THERMITE.skill.md, NOT the README headline flip — those are separate steps):

1. thermite2-semantics.md (the single normative semantics home, AC-13). Create it at the repo root (or .design/ if that matches the existing thermite-design.md placement). It is the ONE authoritative place the shipped Stage-1 semantics live, consolidating what is currently scattered across module-header comments — GROUNDED in the SHIPPED code on main (read it; quote it). Cover: (a) the L0..L4 ladder with the new L3 (Verus/Z3 solver) vs L4 (kernel-grounded: nlsat+spine-lemma) boundary and the upward forge-escalation; (b) the seven CertVerdict outcomes (Proved/Counterexample/RealWitness/CovenantRefuted/Stuck/KernelBudget/Timeout) and their exact meaning + the never-converts-silently invariant; (c) the frozen-subset / cage fragment + the relaxable-clause fragment; (d) the div/rem (Euclidean-vs-T-division) and cast (value-preserving vs truncating, the no-overflow source obligation) conventions — the audit F2 corners, stated ONCE normatively here; (e) the covenant (inhabit/falsify, covenant-before-burn) and the trust profiles (solver vs kernel-grounded). Then update the module-header comments in lean/Thermite/ and thermite-lower/ that currently RESTATE these conventions to instead POINT at thermite2-semantics.md (per AC-13: 'module-header comments point at it rather than restating conventions'), re-pinning any doc-drift those edits trigger.

2. The five R-rule candidates in goal.md (AC-13): add R-SIDE-1, R-COV-1, R-BV-1, R-VERDICT-1, R-GATE-1 with their exact normative statements and the stage that enforces each (R-VERDICT-1 = never-converts-silently, enforced NOW in forge/src/verdict.rs; R-COV-1 = covenant-before-burn, enforced NOW in forge/src/covenant_engine.rs; R-GATE-1 = README/docs headline changes at gate time not merge time; R-SIDE-1 = stage-2 restratify Side obligation, forward-looking; R-BV-1 = stage-3 @bv shadow-flag parse gate, forward-looking). Mark the forward-looking ones as candidates for their owning stage. Do NOT change other goal.md rules.

GAUNTLET before each commit: if any .rs/.lean header changed, cargo build -p forge / lake build (spine) must stay green and cargo test -p forge unaffected; doc-drift 0-drift; tooling/reqs check clean; conformance oracle byte-identical (these are doc/comment changes — no behavior change). No stubs/TODOs.

REGISTRY: if a governance REQ entry pattern exists in .design/reqs/registry.toml, register the semantics-doc + R-rules deliverable with typed evidence; else note it under the umbrella REQ-8.

SCOPE GUARDS: do NOT flip the README headline (R-GATE-1 is a separate gate step — you may DOCUMENT the rule in goal.md, but do not edit README.md's claims); no cage/combinator-menu change; never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json. git push is blocked — commit locally, end with a clear summary, the orchestrator pushes. One branch.
